mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the GDP is increasing, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals an improving labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production index by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when both trigger conditions are met, or if the joint correlation between HOUST, RSAFS increases and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease > 0.5% and PAYEMS increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both trigger conditions are met, or if the joint correlation between UNRATE decreases, PAYEMS increases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate coupled with an increase in consumer price index signals inflationary pressures, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when both trigger conditions are met, or if the joint correlation between FEDFUNDS decreases, CPIAUCSL increases and positive 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a robust economic environment, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.5% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when both trigger conditions are met, or if the joint correlation between GDPC1 increases, UNRATE decreases and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
